> **Not yet implemented.** In the current build this command prints
> `report: not implemented yet` and exits with code 2.

## Usage

```text
provenance report [flags]
```

Generate a coverage/progress report from the current branch HEAD.

`--scope` takes a path to a standalone query file or an entity file and resolves it to an entity set; pointed at a Document, the Document's scoped entities become the reporting population.

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | — | emit machine-readable JSON |
| `--metric name` | — | report only the metric with this name |
| `--scope path` | — | path to a query file or entity file that limits the population |
